definition: Any-position acute-pancreatitis ICD-9 577.0 or ICD-10 K85*
limitations: Misses uncoded disease and includes secondary-diagnosis contexts

definition: P0 plus pancreatic enzyme at least 3 times the row-specific upper reference limit
limitations: Low coverage and depends on unit/reference-range quality

definition: At least two positive Atlanta-like evidence domains among pain enzyme and imaging
limitations: Rule-concordant with the adjudicated reference construction

definition: Transparent weighted score 0.35 pain + 0.35 enzyme + 0.30 imaging at threshold 0.40
limitations: Logically equivalent to P3 on complete binary three-domain inputs

definition: Regularized logistic regression using seven frozen evidence features
limitations: Small development set and precision-limited evaluation
